## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] `version` in `lager.json` matches what is deployed (or will be after merge)
- [ ] New logic has app tests (`apps/<slug>/tests/`), see docs/TESTING.md
- [ ] **Privacy** (docs/PRIVACY.md): no instance data, no real names, e-mail addresses, server domains, tokens or keys, in code, tests, seeds or screenshots
